verses.original: Διὸ ἀφέντες τὸν τῆς ἀρχῆς λόγον τοῦ Χριστοῦ φερώμεθα ἐπὶ τὴν τελειότητα μὴ καταβαλλόμενοι πάλιν θεμέλιον μετανοίας ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων καὶ πίστεως ἐπὶ Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Dio aphentes ton tēs archēs logon tou Christou pherōmetha epi tēn teleiotēta mē kataballomenoi palin themelion metanoias apo nekrōn ergōn kai pisteōs epi Theon
verses.literal: Therefore let us leave the - elementary teachings - about Christ [and] go on to - maturity not laying again [the] foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith in God

verses.original: διδαχὴν βαπτισμῶν τε ἐπιθέσεώς χειρῶν τε ἀναστάσεώς νεκρῶν καὶ αἰωνίου κρίματος
verses.transliteration: didachēn baptismōn te epitheseōs cheirōn te anastaseōs nekrōn kai aiōniou krimatos
verses.literal: instruction about baptisms - [the] laying on of hands - [the] resurrection of [the] dead and eternal judgment

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο ποιήσομεν ἐάνπερ ὁ Θεός ἐπιτρέπῃ
verses.transliteration: kai touto poiēsomen eanper ho Theos epitrepē
verses.literal: And this we will do if - God permits

verses.original: γὰρ Ἀδύνατον τοὺς ἅπαξ φωτισθέντας τε γευσαμένους τῆς τῆς ἐπουρανίου δωρεᾶς καὶ γενηθέντας μετόχους Ἁγίου Πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: gar Adynaton tous hapax phōtisthentas te geusamenous tēs tēs epouraniou dōreas kai genēthentas metochous Hagiou Pneumatos
verses.literal: - [It is] impossible for those who vvv have once been enlightened - [who] have tasted the - heavenly gift - [who] have shared . . . in [the] Holy Spirit

verses.original: καὶ γευσαμένους καλὸν ῥῆμα Θεοῦ τε δυνάμεις μέλλοντος αἰῶνος
verses.transliteration: kai geusamenous kalon rhēma Theou te dynameis mellontos aiōnos
verses.literal: - who have tasted [the] goodness [of the] word of God and [the] powers [of the] coming age

verses.original: καὶ παραπεσόντας ἀνακαινίζειν πάλιν εἰς μετάνοιαν ἑαυτοῖς ἀνασταυροῦντας τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ παραδειγματίζοντας
verses.transliteration: kai parapesontas anakainizein palin eis metanoian heautois anastaurountas ton Huion tou Theou kai paradeigmatizontas
verses.literal: and then have fallen away to be restored . . . to repentance because they themselves are crucifying the Son - of God {all over again} and subjecting [Him] to open shame

verses.original: γὰρ Γῆ ἡ πιοῦσα τὸν ὑετόν πολλάκις ἐρχόμενον ἐπ’ αὐτῆς καὶ τίκτουσα βοτάνην εὔθετον ἐκείνοις δι’ οὓς καὶ γεωργεῖται μεταλαμβάνει εὐλογίας ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar Gē hē piousa ton hyeton pollakis erchomenon ep’ autēs kai tiktousa botanēn eutheton ekeinois di’ hous kai geōrgeitai metalambanei eulogias apo tou Theou
verses.literal: For land - that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom - it is tended receives [the] blessing of - God

verses.original: δὲ ἐκφέρουσα ἀκάνθας καὶ τριβόλους ἀδόκιμος καὶ κατάρας ἐγγύς ἧς τὸ τέλος εἰς καῦσιν
verses.transliteration: de ekpherousa akanthas kai tribolous adokimos kai kataras engys hēs to telos eis kausin
verses.literal: But [land that] produces thorns and thistles [is] worthless and [its] curse is imminent [In] the end vvv it will be burned

verses.original: δὲ καὶ εἰ λαλοῦμεν οὕτως ἀγαπητοί Πεπείσμεθα τὰ κρείσσονα περὶ ὑμῶν καὶ ἐχόμενα σωτηρίας
verses.transliteration: de kai ei laloumen houtōs agapētoi Pepeismetha ta kreissona peri hymōn kai echomena sōtērias
verses.literal: - Even though we speak like this beloved we are convinced of better [things] in your [case] - [things that] accompany salvation

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς οὐ ἄδικος ἐπιλαθέσθαι ὑμῶν τοῦ ἔργου καὶ τῆς ἀγάπης ἧς ἐνεδείξασθε εἰς αὐτοῦ τὸ ὄνομα διακονήσαντες τοῖς ἁγίοις καὶ διακονοῦντες
verses.transliteration: gar ho Theos ou adikos epilathesthai hymōn tou ergou kai tēs agapēs hēs enedeixasthe eis autou to onoma diakonēsantes tois hagiois kai diakonountes
verses.literal: For - God [is] not unjust He will not forget your - work and the love - you have shown for His - name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to [do so]

verses.original: δὲ Ἐπιθυμοῦμεν ἕκαστον ὑμῶν ἐνδείκνυσθαι τὴν αὐτὴν σπουδὴν ἄχρι τέλους πρὸς τῆς ἐλπίδος τὴν πληροφορίαν
verses.transliteration: de Epithymoumen hekaston hymōn endeiknysthai tēn autēn spoudēn achri telous pros tēs elpidos tēn plērophorian
verses.literal: - We want each of you to show [this] same diligence to [the very] end in order {to make} [your] hope - sure

verses.original: ἵνα μὴ νωθροὶ δὲ γένησθε μιμηταὶ τῶν διὰ πίστεως καὶ μακροθυμίας κληρονομούντων τὰς ἐπαγγελίας
verses.transliteration: hina mē nōthroi de genēsthe mimētai tōn dia pisteōs kai makrothymias klēronomountōn tas epangelias
verses.literal: Then vvv you will not be sluggish but vvv will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit - what has been promised

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ Θεός ἐπαγγειλάμενος Τῷ Ἀβραὰμ ἐπεὶ εἶχεν οὐδενὸς μείζονος ὀμόσαι κατ’ ὤμοσεν καθ’ ἑαυτοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar ho Theos epangeilamenos Tō Abraam epei eichen oudenos meizonos omosai kat’ ōmosen kath’ heautou
verses.literal: [When] - God made His promise - to Abraham since He had no one greater to swear by He swore by Himself

verses.original: λέγων μὴν Εἰ εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσω σε καὶ πληθύνων πληθυνῶ σε
verses.transliteration: legōn mēn Ei eulogōn eulogēsō se kai plēthynōn plēthynō se
verses.literal: saying {I will} surely . . . vvv bless you and multiply . . . your [descendants]

verses.original: καὶ οὕτως μακροθυμήσας ἐπέτυχεν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας
verses.transliteration: kai houtōs makrothymēsas epetychen tēs epangelias
verses.literal: And so [Abraham] after waiting patiently obtained the promise

verses.original: γὰρ Ἄνθρωποι ὀμνύουσιν κατὰ τοῦ μείζονος καὶ ὁ ὅρκος εἰς βεβαίωσιν πέρας πάσης αὐτοῖς ἀντιλογίας
verses.transliteration: gar Anthrōpoi omnyousin kata tou meizonos kai ho horkos eis bebaiōsin peras pasēs autois antilogias
verses.literal: - Men swear by [someone] greater [than themselves] and [their] oath serves as a confirmation to end all - argument

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ὁ Θεὸς βουλόμενος ἐπιδεῖξαι τὸ ἀμετάθετον τῆς αὐτοῦ βουλῆς περισσότερον τοῖς κληρονόμοις τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἐμεσίτευσεν ὅρκῳ
verses.transliteration: en hō ho Theos boulomenos epideixai to ametatheton tēs autou boulēs perissoteron tois klēronomois tēs epangelias emesiteusen horkō
verses.literal: vvv So when - God wanted to make the unchanging nature of His purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise He guaranteed [it] with an oath

verses.original: ἵνα διὰ δύο ἀμεταθέτων πραγμάτων ἐν οἷς ἀδύνατον Θεόν ψεύσασθαι τὸν οἱ καταφυγόντες κρατῆσαι τῆς ἐλπίδος προκειμένης ἔχωμεν ἰσχυρὰν παράκλησιν
verses.transliteration: hina dia dyo ametathetōn pragmatōn en hois adynaton Theon pseusasthai ton hoi kataphygontes kratēsai tēs elpidos prokeimenēs echōmen ischyran paraklēsin
verses.literal: Thus by two unchangeable things in which [it is] impossible [for] God to lie - - we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before [us] may be strongly encouraged

verses.original: ἔχομεν ἣν ὡς ἄγκυραν τῆς ψυχῆς τε ἀσφαλῆ καὶ βεβαίαν καὶ εἰσερχομένην εἰς τὸ ἐσώτερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος
verses.transliteration: echomen hēn hōs ankyran tēs psychēs te asphalē kai bebaian kai eiserchomenēn eis to esōteron tou katapetasmatos
verses.literal: We have [this hope] as an anchor for the soul - firm and secure - It enters . . . the inner [sanctuary] [behind] the curtain

verses.original: ὅπου Ἰησοῦς πρόδρομος εἰσῆλθεν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν γενόμενος ἀρχιερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ
verses.transliteration: hopou Iēsous prodromos eisēlthen hyper hēmōn genomenos archiereus eis ton aiōna kata tēn taxin Melchisedek
verses.literal: where Jesus [our] forerunner has entered vvv on our behalf He has become a high priest vvv vvv forever in the order of Melchizedek
